claim_text: Methylcobalamin is one supplemental form of vitamin B12, but available evidence does not establish that it is routinely clinically superior to other effective B12 forms for general supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid unsupported or unnecessary supplementation.

population.other_context: Vegan users with low fortified-food intake considering methylcobalamin.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin B12 Health Professional Fact Sheet describes supplemental forms and reliable B12 sources.
limitations: Product form does not remove the need to assess dose, adherence, absorption and clinical status.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
